provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Imaging and functional QC for printed constructs. In the 3D Bioprinted Human Organs (Kidney/Heart/Liver) system this piece plays the safety role: it verifies every organ Maturity: developing.
key_points: Quality Control: Imaging and functional QC for printed constructs.
Role: Safety — it verifies every organ.
how_it_works: Install the Quality Control stack and its dependencies in a clean environment.
Feed it the reference dataset and confirm the reference output.
Connect it to the live 3D Bioprinted Human Organs (Kidney/Heart/Liver) data path.
Monitor outputs for drift and re-validate on the schedule.
standards: Automated test suite with coverage gates
safety: Never run untrusted code on production data
Back up data before migration steps
Sandbox experimental builds
Log and review privileged actions
troubleshooting: Wrong output: run the reference dataset to isolate data vs code
Crashes: reproduce with the minimal input, then bisect
Slow: profile before optimizing; check I/O and memory first
Drift over time: re-validate against the pinned reference
citations: Documented public research on 3D Bioprinted Human Organs (Kidney/Heart/Liver): peer-reviewed literature, technical standards, industry announcements, and open technical documentation.

title: Regulatory Pathway
provenance: Public research knowledge: documented developments, published research, and established technical references. Real, fact-checked records.
description: Combination-product pathway for living constructs. In the 3D Bioprinted Human Organs (Kidney/Heart/Liver) system this piece plays the approval role: it approves printed organs Maturity: emerging.

how_it_works: Prepare the work environment and tooling to the process recipe.
Run the Regulatory Pathway sequence exactly per the documented recipe.
Measure the outcome at each control checkpoint.
Accept, rework, or scrap the batch based on measured results.
